description: Build an Earn action for the key's wallet to sign: deposit, withdraw (USDG lent), borrow, repay, addCollateral, withdrawCollateral, revoke, multiply (leverage on a Stock Token in one transaction), repayWithCollateral (sell part of the collateral to repay, max to repay it all), vaultDeposit, vaultWithdraw. Same checks as trnch.fun/earn: listed markets and vaults only, Trnch max LTV, exact approvals, receiver is always the wallet. The Trnch fee (borrow, repay, Multiply) and the swap fee are in preview. Returns { calls, preview, chainId, from }: send calls in order from the key's wallet (chainId 4663); each was simulated on chain before being returned. Nothing is sent by Trnch. multiply and repayWithCollateral: send the calls as one atomic batch (EIP-5792) or, one by one, ALWAYS send the last call (it removes an approval), even if an earlier one failed. Requires an API key (created by wallet signature), sent as Authorization: Bearer <key>.

amount.description: Amount in token units, or max; borrow also takes ltv:20|35|50|max. repayWithCollateral: collateral to sell.

collateral.description: borrow and multiply: collateral to supply, or wallet for the whole balance.

leverage.description: multiply: target leverage, 1.2 up to the Trnch cap, or max.

title: Build an Earn transaction
